title: Lamongan Soto
description: Authentic Lamongan soto with koya, shredded chicken, and clear turmeric broth.
ingredients: Koya: crushed prawn crackers and fried garlic
instructions: Boil chicken until tender. Shred the meat.
Make broth with turmeric and spices.
Serve with glass noodles, cabbage, shredded chicken, and egg.
Top with koya.
Add lime and sambal to taste.

title: Gudeg Manggar Recipe: Yogyakarta Jackfruit Stew with Coconut Blossom
description: Traditional Yogyakarta gudeg with added manggar (coconut blossom) for extra texture.
instructions: Boil jackfruit and manggar until tender
Combine with chicken skin in pot
Add coconut milk, palm sugar, bay leaves, lemongrass, and galangal
Add teak leaves for color
Simmer for 2 hours until liquid reduces
Season with salt
Serve with steamed rice, boiled egg, and sambal krechek

title: Pecel Lele Bledegan Recipe: Fried Catfish with Special Sambal
description: Deep-fried catfish served with special bledegan sambal from Lamongan.
ingredients: Sambal: 10 red chilies, 5 shallots, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp shrimp paste, 1 tomato
instructions: Clean catfish, rub with turmeric and salt
Deep fry until crispy
Make sambal: grind chilies, shallots, garlic, shrimp paste, and tomato
Fry sambal until fragrant
Serve catfish with sambal and fresh vegetables

title: Makassar Beef Rib Soup
description: Rich and aromatic beef rib soup from Makassar with keluak nuts.
ingredients: Ground spice paste: 10 shallots, 6 garlic cloves, 3 cm ginger, 2 cm turmeric, 1 tbsp coriander, 1 tsp pepper, 3 candlenuts
instructions: Boil ribs in water for 2 hours until very tender. Reserve broth.
Crush keluak nut flesh into a paste.
Sauté ground spice paste with lemongrass and lime leaves until fragrant.
Add keluak paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour into rib broth and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt. Serve with rice, spring onions, and fried shallots.

title: Ayam Bakar Madura Recipe: Madurese Grilled Chicken
description: Sweet and spicy grilled chicken from Madura, known for its caramelized sweet soy glaze.
instructions: Grind shallots, garlic, coriander, and pepper
Marinate chicken with spice paste, sweet soy sauce, tamarind, and palm sugar
Let rest for 2 hours
Grill over charcoal, basting frequently
Turn until chicken is charred and glazed
Serve with steamed rice and sambal

title: Tahu Petis Recipe: Tofu in Shrimp Paste Sauce
description: Fried tofu served with rich petis (shrimp paste) sauce, a popular Surabaya street food.
instructions: Fry tofu until crispy
Sauté garlic, add petis and water
Cook until sauce thickens
Arrange tofu, rice cakes, and bean sprouts
Pour petis sauce over
Garnish with fried shallots

title: Kue Mendut Recipe: Javanese Coconut Rice Dumpling
description: Soft rice flour dumpling filled with sweet coconut, served in warm coconut milk.
ingredients: Coconut milk sauce: 400ml coconut milk, 2 pandan leaves, salt
instructions: Cook filling until dry and sweet
Mix rice flour, coconut milk, salt, and coloring into dough
Form balls, fill with coconut mixture
Boil in water until they float
Make coconut milk sauce
Serve dumplings warm in coconut milk sauce

title: Es Sop Duren Recipe: Durian Fruit Soup Ice
description: Rich durian dessert soup with coconut milk, jackfruit, and tapioca pearls over ice.
instructions: Cook tapioca pearls until translucent
Mash durian with a little coconut milk
Assemble: ice, durian paste, jackfruit, tapioca
Pour coconut milk over
Drizzle with condensed milk and palm sugar syrup
Serve immediately

title: Bika Ambon Recipe: Honeycomb Cake
description: Fragrant honeycomb-textured cake made from tapioca, yeast, and aromatic pandan and lime.
instructions: Dissolve sugar in warm coconut milk with pandan and lime leaves
Cool and add yeast, let ferment for 1 hour
Mix with tapioca flour, eggs, salt, and coloring
Let batter ferment for 3 hours
Pour into greased pan
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes
Cool before slicing to reveal honeycomb texture

title: Kue Apem Recipe: Traditional Fermented Rice Cake
description: Soft fermented rice flour cake with palm sugar, steamed until fluffy.
instructions: Dissolve palm sugar in warm coconut milk
Cool and add yeast
Mix with rice flour and salt
Let batter rest for 2 hours
Pour into molds
Steam for 20 minutes
Serve warm

title: Gulai Otak Recipe: Brain Curry
description: Beef brain simmered in rich spiced coconut curry, a delicacy in Padang cuisine.
instructions: Clean beef brain, blanch in boiling water
Grind shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric, chilies, and coriander
Sauté paste with lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves
Add coconut milk and bring to simmer
Gently add brain pieces
Cook for 15 minutes without stirring too much
Season and serve with steamed rice

title: Sate Kuda Recipe: Horse Meat Satay
description: Tender horse meat satay from Lombok, marinated in spices and grilled over charcoal.
instructions: Grind shallots, garlic, turmeric, coriander, and pepper
Marinate horse meat cubes for 2 hours
Thread onto bamboo skewers
Grill over charcoal, basting with sweet soy sauce
Cook until medium-well
Serve with peanut sauce and rice cakes

title: Kue Kemplang Recipe: Palembang Fish Crackers
description: Crispy fish crackers from Palembang, grilled or fried, served with peanut dipping sauce.
instructions: Grind fish with garlic until smooth
Mix with tapioca flour, salt, pepper, and water
Knead into dough
Shape into thin rounds
Sun-dry until hard
Deep fry until they puff up
Serve with peanut sauce

title: Sop Saudara Recipe: Makassar Beef Soup
description: A Makassar specialty of beef soup with a rich, spiced broth, served with ketupat (rice cake), crispy shallots, and a fiery sambal.
ingredients: Ground spice paste: 8 shallots, 5 garlic cloves, 3 cm ginger, 2 cm turmeric, 1 tsp pepper, 2 candlenuts
Fried shallots, spring onions, lime, sambal
instructions: Boil beef until tender. Reserve broth.
Sauté spice paste with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and galangal.
Add beef broth and coconut milk.
Return beef and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve over ketupat with fried shallots, spring onions, lime, and sambal.

title: Ayam Goreng Kalasan Premium Recipe: Premium Yogyakarta Fried Chicken
description: Premium free-range chicken simmered in spiced coconut milk then deep fried with crispy kremes.
instructions: Simmer chicken in spiced coconut milk until tender
Remove and cool slightly
Make thin rice flour batter with turmeric
Deep fry chicken until golden
Drizzle batter into oil for crispy kremes
Serve with steamed rice, sambal, and fresh vegetables

title: Ikan Mujair Bakar Premium Recipe: Premium Grilled Tilapia
description: Premium whole tilapia grilled with special spice paste and kecombrang for aromatic flavor.
instructions: Clean and score fish
Grind turmeric, shallots, and garlic
Add sliced kecombrang
Rub paste all over fish
Wrap in banana leaves
Grill over charcoal for 15 minutes each side
Serve with sambal and fresh vegetables
